# parlay-club

> Docs map generated by `good-vibes docs index`. Edit the docs, then regenerate this file.

## Decision

- [Unify player identity across sportsbooks](canonical-player-identity.md): Normalize and resolve player identity once during prop ingest (stripping trailing `(TEAM)` tags, normalizing punctuation/suffixes/casing, and matching against team rosters) so stored odds and board grouping share one canonical player ID, name, and team rather than raw provider strings.
- [Deepen eval replay and comparison fidelity](deepen-eval-fidelity.md): Deepen eval replay and comparison fidelity
- [Deepen pick-board read assembly and current-odds filtering](deepen-pick-board.md): Filter superseded odds rows at the storage seam and deepen the board module to own scoped board assembly, signal attachment on paired line groups, and picked-leg drift state across full-page and partial views.
- [Deepen analyzer and board signal loading](deepen-signal-loader.md): Deepen analyzer and board signal loading
- [Track prop selections dynamically when lines move](dynamic-line-tracking.md): Separate selection identity (`game`, `canonical player`, `market`, `side`) from the quoted `line` and `odds`, so board matching, leg updates, and sportsbook export look up the target selection dynamically and resolve each book's current line, price, and deep-link selection ID.
- [Dynamic NFL schedule slip management and data loading](dynamic-nfl-schedule-slips.md): Replace weekday-hardcoded automation with a **game-day-driven** model: the stored NFL scoreboard is the source of truth for when slates exist, when recurring slips should be created, and when morning pre-fill should run.
- [Fix DraftKings and FanDuel export links](export-deep-links.md): Fix DraftKings and FanDuel export links
- [FAQ and docs primary view](faq-docs-view.md): FAQ and docs primary view
- [Run Sunday prefill on first authenticated visit](first-sunday-visit-prefill.md): Trigger the Sunday pre-fill from the background page-load refresh when a signed-in user visits on Sunday morning in Eastern time, guarded by persisted sync state so it runs at most once per Sunday.
- [Reduce Cloud Run and storage costs](gcp-cost-optimization.md): Tighten live SSE stream lifetimes and client idle behavior alongside Litestream replication and GCS bucket retention settings: - Skip opening live streams on already-graded slips, shorten server idle/live stream caps (with seamless reconnect on activity or focus), and pause the browser's stream after a few minutes of no user interaction (reconnecting and refreshing immediately when the user returns).
- [A-grade leg and parlay highlights](grade-highlights.md): A-grade leg and parlay highlights
- [Grading evals and calibration](grading-evals.md): ### Before ### After Version the grading rubric in Go and build an offline, leak-free historical replayer and eval runner that scores past weeks across rubric versions and compares calibration against actual leg and parlay outcomes.
- [Calibrated v2 grading and prediction model](grading-model-v2.md): Calibrated v2 grading and prediction model
- [Auto-grading and Record Book](grading-record-book.md): Grade legs automatically from ESPN box scores once games end, with hand overrides.
- [Automated grading evals and in-app results page](grading-results.md): Automated grading evals and in-app results page
- [Redesign per-group landing page](group-landing-overview.md): Turn the per-group entry point into a state-aware group landing page that always renders a coherent overview, elevating active or soon-upcoming slips into a hero spotlight when present.
- [Implied percentage chances on legs and parlays](implied-chance-display.md): Implied percentage chances on legs and parlays
- [Include roster injuries in leg grading](injury-aware-grading.md): Include roster injuries in leg grading
- [Live parlay and leg progress bars with live hit probability](live-parlay-progress.md): Live parlay and leg progress bars with live hit probability
- [Market-wide grading evaluation](market-wide-grading-eval.md): Market-wide grading evaluation
- [nflverse signals for leg suggestions and grading](nflverse-signals.md): Add `nflverse` as a free, weekly lazy-synced source alongside `nfelo`, then feed its team-defense EPA, player usage, and snap-share signals into two pure, deterministic layers: sharp-friend **leg and slip grades** in the analyzer, and **matchup/script badges** on the pick board.
- [Smooth out one-off slip flow](one-off-slip-flow.md): Keep the single-slip redirect for normal weeks, and expose a clean, optional path to add a one-off slip directly on the slip hub.
- [Speed up pick board and page loads](pick-board-performance.md): Pre-index roster lookups once per board build instead of scanning and normalizing the full roster for every selection, move pick-time odds refreshes off the synchronous request path so clicks always render from stored data and push live updates over SSE, and allow concurrent SQLite WAL readers so reads do not stall behind background sync writes.
- [Player research charts and matchup context](player-research-qol.md): Player research charts and matchup context
- [Consolidate selection and player identity](selection-player-identity.md): Consolidate canonical player resolution, selection and line-group identity, and selection text formatting into one deep domain module that every ingest, board, slip, research, export, and grading path calls.
- [Sharp bookmaker odds comparison](sharp-book-grading.md): ### Before ### After Compute a deterministic sharp benchmark from stored multi-book odds, de-vig two-way sharp quotes, and feed the retail-versus-sharp line and price gap into the analyzer's Line & Price scoring category.
- [Show one standard line per player prop](single-standard-prop-line.md): Filter prop feeds to standard lines at ingest (rejecting `goblin`/`demon` tags and picking each book's primary balanced line when a book returns multiple unlabeled alternates) and pair board rows by canonical player + market + side rather than raw player name and line number.
- [Semantic theme system and three selectable site styles](site-themes.md): Semantic theme system and three selectable site styles
- [Redesign slip creation UX](slip-creation-ux.md): Unify slip creation around upcoming weeks and split the scope controls by slip type: recurring slips pick a repeating slate rule, while one-off slips pick exact games with slate shortcuts.
- [Sunday morning odds pre-fill and smart refresh](sunday-odds-prefill.md): Add an authenticated Sunday 9:30 AM Eastern pre-fill trigger that warms the slate, game lines, and Parlay API bulk props for all upcoming games, sync free news and roster sources much more often, and move post-prefill odds and prop refreshes strictly to when players are selecting a line on an open slip.
- [Unify slip analysis and rubric grading](unify-analyzer-evaluation.md): Unify slip analysis and rubric grading
- [Unify auto-grade and eval-cache invalidation](unify-eval-cache-invalidation.md): Unify auto-grade and eval-cache invalidation
- [Unify live and historical signal loading](unify-signal-and-archive-seam.md): Unify live and historical signal loading
